biomarkers.name: HPV / p16
biomarkers.prevalence: Subset; variable by geography and assay
biomarkers.clinical_use: HPV may contribute in some cases, but p16 is not a definitive surrogate marker for HPV-driven disease in conjunctival SCC

biomarkers.name: HIV status / immunosuppression
biomarkers.prevalence: Higher in HIV+ and immunosuppressed patients
biomarkers.clinical_use: OSSN is more common and can be more aggressive in HIV+ populations, especially in sub-Saharan Africa

biomarkers.name: UV signature mutations (TP53, CDKN2A, TERT promoter)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports UV-driven pathogenesis; TP53, CDKN2A, and TERT promoter alterations are recurrent

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Squamous cell carcinoma arising from conjunctival epithelium, often at the limbus

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: UV-driven high mutational burden in some cases; HPV-associated inflammatory features in a subset
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Substantia propria stroma; often with pterygium-like appearance

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Conjunctival epithelial cells, often arising at the limbal corneal-conjunctival junction
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Keratinizing or non-keratinizing squamous; CIN (conjunctival intraepithelial neoplasia) is a precursor lesion
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: CIN  invasive SCC sequence at the limbal transition zone; HIV-associated immunosuppression is linked to increased incidence and progression; HPV involvement is reported in a subset
